items.en: Most people make songpyeon, which is a traditional Korean rice cake.

fix.from: Most people make Song-Pyun which is a Korean traditional rice cake.
fix.why: 하나뿐인 송편을 덧붙여 설명하므로 쉼표 + which(계속적 용법). 형용사 순서 traditional Korean, 표기 songpyeon(STUDENT s18-3 과 같은 꼴).

items.en: She has a bird the color of which is beautiful.

fix.from: She has a bird of which color is beautiful. (= whose)
fix.why: of which 는 the color of which 또는 of which the color 꼴로만 씀. '(= whose)'는 a bird whose color is beautiful 과 뜻이 같다는 설명이라 설명 카드 표로 옮김.

discovery.question: which 가 꾸미는 말(songpyeon · a bird · a dog)의 공통점은?
discovery.why: 선행사가 사물이나 동물이면 which 를 써요(사람이면 who).

blocks.title: 사물 · 동물을 꾸밀 때: which
points: 선행사가 사물이나 동물이면 which 를 써요: a dog which my son likes
which 는 주어 자리(which is …)에도, 목적어 자리(which my son likes)에도 써요.
'그것의 ~'는 whose 나 the + 명사 + of which: a bird the color of which …
쉼표 + which 는 앞 말을 덧붙여 설명해요(계속적 용법): songpyeon, which is …
'그중 대부분'은 쉼표 + most of which: the cookies, most of which …

rows: 전치사 + which (the chair on which I sat)

blocks.koDiff: 한국어는 '한국의 전통 떡인 송편'처럼 앞에서 꾸미지만, 영어는 songpyeon 뒤에 쉼표와 which 를 붙여 덧붙여 설명해요.

mistakes.wrong: She has a bird of which color is beautiful.
mistakes.right: She has a bird the color of which is beautiful.
mistakes.why: of which 앞에 꾸밈을 받는 명사(the color)를 먼저 써요. whose 로 쓰면 a bird whose color is beautiful.

mistakes.wrong: The chair which I sat on it was broken.
mistakes.right: The chair which I sat on was broken.
mistakes.why: which 가 이미 on 의 목적어(it) 자리를 맡았어요. it 을 또 쓰지 않아요.

select.instruction: 관계대명사 which 가 꾸며 주는 것(선행사)을 누르세요
select.why: which my son likes 는 dog 를 꾸며요: '내 아들이 좋아하는 개'.

select.instruction: 쉼표 뒤 which 문장의 뜻으로 알맞은 것을 고르세요
select.sentence: Most people make songpyeon, which is a traditional Korean rice cake.
options: 송편을 만든다 — 그런데 송편은 한국의 전통 떡이다

select.instruction: 두 문장을 한 문장으로 이을 때 빈칸에 알맞은 한 낱말을 쓰세요: I have many books. + Most of them are old.
select.sentence: I have many books, most of ___ are old.
select.why: 쉼표 뒤, 사물(books)이라 most of which. 쉼표 뒤와 전치사 뒤에는 that 을 쓰지 않아요.

select.instruction: 밑줄 친 which 는 뒤 문장에서 어떤 자리를 맡나요?
select.sentence: I have a dog which my son likes.
select.why: which 가 likes 의 목적어 자리를 맡아요(my son likes the dog).
